issues.description: The return type of Stock.take(...) is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem UML and the solution implementation expect take to return an int (e.g., -1 on failure, remaining quantity on success), but the template Stock.take(...) is declared to return boolean. This mismatch can confuse students and block them when they implement SealSaloon (which, per the specification, and as shown in the solution, relies on an int-returning take method).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Stock.take(String) method signature match the problem UML and the solution by changing its return type from boolean to int. Implement its behavior to return -1 when the ingredient is missing or quantity insufficient, and otherwise decrement quantity and return the remaining quantity. Update any code comments or documentation to reflect the int return contract.
